# Both passes with the repository bound read-only, in a mount namespace of
# their own, as pass 1's job has it. Pass 1 reads it and passes. Pass 2 cannot
# write its lock: the backend retries the lock file for 15 minutes, then
# "unable to create lock in backend: … read-only file system", exit code 1.
# The "1 additional files" note is a pack an interrupted backup left.
$ restic --cache-dir /tmp/pocketcloud-check-cache --cleanup-cache --no-lock check --read-data-subset=1/20

read group #1 of 4 data packs (out of total 80 packs in 20 groups)
[0:00] 100.00%  4 / 4 packs
no errors were found
--- stderr
--- exit 0
